_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBAaQW5g4DKEMyfrDWjAqdoh)_
Refs #26924

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file changes; the one sentence that teaches `newTabUrl` (`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`) already teaches a backend path since #27252. Not Tier H.

This PR carries the contract-review FAIL items of record 6470108120 on #27252, found after the maintainer had queued #27252 (queued 13:21Z, record 13:21Z, merged 13:42Z as `c13ef04c3`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：为 #27252 已上线的 `newTabUrl` 收窄补登 ADR-0087 D3 语义条目 `ui-action-new-tab-url-path-refused`（结构化 TODO，两种改法都写明，不做自动转换）；动作表单该字段的标签在四种语言里都改为「路径」。
- 为什么改：合约复核 6470108120 判 #27252 的 ADR-0087 处置写成 `not-required`，但变更说明里带了改法，应登记条目；复核结果出来时 #27252 已在合并队列里，所以补在这里。
- 风险与回滚：不改任何可写取值；条目只进迁移登记表（升级指南与 `os migrate meta` 的待办），标签仅文字。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-action-new-tab-url-path-refused.ts`、`.changeset/26924-new-tab-url-d3-entry.md`、`packages/spec/src/ui/action.form.ts`；文档 `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` 一句改为「本后端路径」。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:migration-registry && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/migrations`，预期全部通过，且生成的登记表含 `ui-action-new-tab-url-path-refused`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **ADR-0087 registration.** New D3 semantic entry `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-action-new-tab-url-path-refused.ts` (protocol 18), following the in-tree `18.*-refused.ts` shape (`18.ui-action-undoable-unfulfillable-refused.ts`):
  - `surface`: an `action` document (standalone, an object's `actions[]`, or type-level) whose `newTabUrl` does not start with `/`.
  - `replacement`: the backend path (`newTabUrl: '/sso-open/{recordId}'`), or for an external page drop `opensInNewTab` / `newTabUrl` and declare a `type: 'url'` action (`target: 'https://example.com/export/${ctx.recordId}'`, `openIn: 'new-tab'`). Stated as **not mechanically convertible, a structured TODO**: an external URL names no path on this backend, and the url-action rewrite changes `type`, drops the action's own `target` / `body` handler and replaces the auth-enforcing endpoint with a page the browser opens directly, so which remedy the author meant is not recorded anywhere.
  - `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria`: the console's origin-prefix behaviour, why the set is closed rather than widened, and the stored-row behaviour already pinned by #27252 (loads unchanged and registered, `invalid` with a `[metadata_spec_invalid]` boot line, `_diagnostics` at `newTabUrl`, next save 422 `INVALID_METADATA`).
  - `ActionSchema.newTabUrl`'s JSDoc names the entry.
- **Changeset.** The merged `.changeset/26924-new-tab-url-backend-path.md` is not edited (`check-empty-changeset` refuses edits to a changeset the merge base carries). A new `.changeset/26924-new-tab-url-d3-entry.md` (`@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch) carries `adr-0087: registered ui-action-new-tab-url-path-refused` and a "Supersedes, in the same release" paragraph that replaces the earlier `not-required` disposition. Both packages are unreleased since #27252, so the two notes ship together.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` called `newTabUrl` a "new-tab target template", which reads as a URL after #27252; it now says a path on this backend starting with `/`, and points an external page at a `type: 'url'` action with `openIn: 'new-tab'` (flagged by the docs-drift check on this PR).
- **Form label.** `action.form.ts` labels `newTabUrl` "New-tab path"; `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` is regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`. zh-CN 「新标签页路径」, ja-JP 「新しいタブのパス」, es-ES "Ruta de pestaña nueva": translated-locale values are hand-authored (AGENTS.md documentation guardrails: the generator rewrites only `en` and keeps every translated value), so they are edited in place and the generator re-run reports them in sync.

## Tests

- No new test: the entry is data the registry tests read. `gen:migration-registry` then `src/migrations` + `src/conversions` → see Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- No `refused-shapes.ts` detector is added for the entry; the review asked for the D3 entry. A detector would make `os migrate meta --stored` list each stored row by name; that can follow if the seat wants it.
- The missing `skills/objectstack-ui/evals` case for `newTabUrl` stays with the lane seat, as noted at ACCEPT.

## Verification

Head `78e8f9751`: two commits on `7858c1d16`, 9 paths. `0c704ce93` carries the entry, the changeset and the labels (8 paths, +61/-7); `78e8f9751` is the one-line docs edit.

VERDICT command-exit 0, 891 s.
- `src/migrations` + `src/conversions` after `gen:migration-registry`: 28 files / 945 tests passed; the generated registry carries `ui-action-new-tab-url-path-refused`.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exit 0, which does not judge this marker: the gate reads only changesets that declare a breaking change, and this one is a patch. The marker was checked by hand instead: the entry file name, its exported `id` and the marker all read `ui-action-new-tab-url-path-refused`, and the generated registry carries it. `check-empty-changeset` exit 0 (the merged changeset is untouched).
- Derived gates: on `0c704ce93`, 80 families were derived and all 80 ran serially, every one exit 0. With the docs commit the derivation is 101; the 21 new families plus every docs/link/affected-docs family (31 in all) were rerun on `78e8f9751`, every one exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran` on `78e8f9751`: 101 derived, 101 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
